domains.name: Financial Access Infrastructure
domains.description: Financial infrastructure enables economic participation and strengthens institutional financial systems.
domains.detail: PAG supports initiatives that expand financial access through secure digital platforms, payment systems, and financial technology infrastructure.

domains.name: Digital Identity & Security Systems
domains.description: Modern institutional systems rely on secure identity platforms that enable reliable verification and access control.
domains.detail: PAG supports the deployment of digital identity infrastructure and secure technology platforms designed to strengthen institutional capacity and protect sensitive data environments.

domains.name: Smart Mobility Systems
domains.description: Urban development increasingly relies on intelligent mobility platforms that improve transportation efficiency and accessibility.
domains.detail: PAG works with technology partners and infrastructure stakeholders to support the deployment of modern mobility systems integrating monitoring, management, and operational technologies.

domains.name: Government Digital Infrastructure
domains.description: Governments across emerging markets are implementing digital platforms to improve public services and administrative efficiency.
domains.detail: PAG supports the development and deployment of digital government infrastructure including secure platforms, data systems, and institutional technology environments.

domains.name: Supply Chain Enablement
domains.description: Complex infrastructure programs depend on resilient supply chain systems that can support procurement, logistics coordination, and sustained delivery.
domains.detail: PAG supports mission-critical supply chain enablement for institutional programs by aligning international suppliers, logistics pathways, and implementation requirements across regulated operating environments.
